gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-zen-maru-gothic: Loose, wobbly, hand-drawn fun: that's Shantell Sans, with its wide-open mouths. Zen Maru Gothic is a plain sans that never snags on a closed-up bowl, so paragraphs feel like following a single thread.
gen-gf-sniglet-fs-alpino: Alpino reads cozy and casual, its tall body making the ascenders look short. Sniglet heads things with terminals that stop short of curling back, while Alpino's tight spacing and well-separated curve endings carry a long stretch of text along.
gen-gf-sniglet-fs-nunito: Approachable, first of all, thanks to Nunito's big round lowercase bowls. Sniglet adds a distinctive, level-beat heading above them, and the two sit together with terminals that stop short or finish clear of the stem.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-alef: Alef reads modern and clean, with curves left open at the ends. Under Sniglet's level, commanding headings, a plain sans like this moves through paragraph after paragraph without any fuss or drag.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-amarna: Clean and contemporary, Amarna keeps every stroke free of contrast. Beneath Sniglet's commanding headings, its unclogged small counters let a sans body roll along smoothly, line after line.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-ar-one-sans: Modern and contemporary, AR One Sans lifts its brush ends away before each curve closes. Sniglet's commanding, lockstep curves and stems sit above it, and a plain sans body like this keeps paragraphs light and moving.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-barlow: Approachable and contemporary, Barlow pulls the tips of its c shapes well apart. Sniglet's commanding heading sits above its constant, neon-tube strokes, so a sans-serif body glides on for paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-biz-udgothic: BIZ UDGothic reads professional and modern, with a wide channel into every bowl. Sniglet's flat, contrast-free headings lead in, and BIZ UDGothic then carries a sans body smoothly down the page without tiring the eye.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-bpmf-huninn: Rounded, outline-like, and distinctly modern. Bpmf Huninn is a sans with a wide channel into every bowl, so nudge its size up slightly beneath Sniglet's commanding heading.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-cairo-play: Cairo Play reads modern and professional, its open round letters staying clear at small sizes. Sniglet shares the page with it through zero modulation in the line, making the commanding heading and the plain sans body feel closely related.
